scope: One complete independent scientific/modern-text gate for the frozen n35 template; no source-page pixels or figure geometry/display review.

scienceChecks.reason: Modern text correctly distinguishes mean squared speed from its square root, the arithmetic mean of speed magnitudes, and an average velocity vector. It explicitly retains the source overbar-v convention as RMS rather than silently redefining that symbol. Single-molecule mass, gas-rest-frame speed, classical equilibrium applicability and absolute kelvin temperature are stated.

Original0 degreesC, nitrogen molar mass0.028kg/mol,500m/s and hydrogen1800m/s remain unchanged. Celsius is explicitly not inserted as the numerical absolute temperature. Values are coarse source estimates of a distribution statistic, not common speeds assigned to all molecules.

reviewerCalculationOnly.note: Hydrogen coarse diatomic molar mass and273K are reviewer dimensional/rounding inputs, not added lesson data. Both calculations are compatible with the retained approximate source figures.

scienceChecks.reason: Rapid between-collision motion is separated from net displacement and cumulative zigzag path length. The dilute collisional model, typical rather than universal individual displacement, and possible room airflow prevent treating molecular speed as macroscopic odor propagation speed. Nineteenth-century/cannon comparison and odor timescale are attributed to source context rather than promoted into modern universal measurements. A/B and AB relationships are unchanged.

Source Stern1920 identity is retained as the source's historical account, consistent with the1920 primary publication. Co-rotating connected concentric cylindersA/B, heated silver-coated platinum wireC, slitO, evacuated flight region, room-temperature collectorB and static silver depositionD retain their source roles. The added heating/evacuation/collection explanations do not introduce an unrelated apparatus. Silver atoms and molecular-beam sampling are not conflated with directly observing the RMS statistic of an arbitrary gas sample.

Radial uniform straight-flight and approximately collision-free assumptions are explicit. In that stated model, transit lengthR_B-R_A and time t give the retained flight-speed formula; collector rotation during that same time gives wall arc offset s. Eliminating t yields the unchanged final speed expression. Wall arc offset is not the atom's flight path. The existing S token remains uppercase and is explicitly the same offset represented by preceding lowercase s; no math token or geometry is silently changed. Beam selection/distribution and deposit width/position are distinguished from a generic arithmetic mean or RMS measurement.

The retained sqrt(3kT/M) is explicitly a kinetic RMS estimate conditional on classical equilibrium and translational equipartition. Its mass/temperature dependence is not claimed to determine finite-time diffusion or observability by itself. Fluid resistance, particle size and observation time qualify displacement observations; large mass is not used to deny the existence of Brownian motion.

Modern footnote appropriately distinguishes finite-time displacement observations, nondifferentiable ideal inertia-free diffusion trajectories, and finite-mass short-time inertial dynamics. It does not assert a universal experimental impossibility of instantaneous velocity measurement. Published direct measurements support rejecting that unrestricted impossibility statement; no experimental setup or new exercise is inserted into the lesson.

nativeBoundaries.after:

nativeBoundaries.before: 原书把实验结果与理论相符作为对公式 $(3-18)$ 及 $(3-15)$ 的支持，但不能据此把任意银带的单一位置或算术平均速率直接等同于均方根速率。
